purpose: Infrastructure milestone: train one existing baseline (GEM) on one non-sensitive object (teapot) on FLUX.1-dev, then publish the actual trained checkpoint artifacts and 20 matched original/edited image pairs.
not_a_claim: This is a source-derived GEM configuration for an ordinary object.
It is NOT an author-validated object benchmark and NOT a reproduction of paper performance.
No erasure-efficacy, retention, SOTA, novelty, evaluator-bias, human-consensus or paper-readiness claim is made.

anchor.source: the pinned source's default EMPTY_CONCEPT (gem/operators/utils.py:3 -> EMPTY_CONCEPT = "")
anchor.note: GEMConfig.anchors defaults to [EMPTY_CONCEPT]; the exact value is the empty string.

adaptation.provenance: GEMConfig.get_default_adaptation_config() -> AdaptationConfig(adapter_mode='lora', subset_name='qk_dual'); LoRA hyperparameters are AdaptationConfig.__post_init__ source defaults.

training.max_step_budget_semantics: The source's own counter: step_budget is decremented by the number of PROCESSED TIMESTEPS per inner batch (num_parallel_steps), not by optimizer updates. 250 counts processed timesteps.

predicted_counters.note: Predictions only. Actual counters are recorded from the run; the native terminal endpoint is used and the schedule is not extended if it exits earlier.

inference.sigmas: np.linspace(1.0, 1/num_timesteps, num_timesteps) with dynamic mu shift via gem FluxPipelineWrapper.set_timesteps/calculate_shift
inference.tokenization: CLIPTokenizer (77) + T5TokenizerFast (max_sequence_length=512 diffusers default); prompt and prompt_2 both set to the case prompt, per gem FluxPipelineWrapper.encode_prompt
inference.initial_noise_handling: Per case: g = torch.Generator(device='cpu').manual_seed(eval_seed); packed initial latents produced by FluxPipeline.prepare_latents(batch=1, ...) with that generator, captured, sha256-hashed, saved, and then passed explicitly as `latents=` to BOTH the M0 and edited runs so the two conditions provably share identical initial noise.

deviations_from_source_defaults.reason: Mandated by the assignment. Disclosed; no precision search was performed.
Mandated by the assignment. Disclosed; no batch search was performed. Reduces per-iteration activation memory; the step budget still counts the same processed timesteps.
Assignment target; anchor is the pinned source default.
One production training seed fixed in advance and distinct from the smoke seed (101) and the 20 evaluation seeds (7001-7020).

unchanged_from_source: max_step_budget (250 is already the source default)
image_size (512 is already the source default)
LoRA rank/alpha/dropout/bias, qk_dual subset, AdamW, learning rate, gamma, eta, loss, all trajectory settings

seeds.distinctness: production training seed is distinct from the smoke seed and from every evaluation seed

retry_policy.scope: Permitted only for a technical cause (crash, OOM, corrupt state, host/device failure) within an UNCHANGED scientific configuration and the same ceilings.
retry_policy.forbidden: Never retry because erasure or appearance is disappointing. The predetermined native terminal endpoint is used; interrupted endpoints are labelled partial.
retry_policy.resume_rule: Resume only with trustworthy state; a fresh restart is not an exact continuation and is labelled as such.

publication.checkpoint_representation: native: GEM's save_pipeline writes the merged post-LoRA `transformer/` component (the author's own representation). A pre-merge native LoRA adapter is published alongside it as a convenience; the two are NOT claimed to be bit-identical.
